title: Pure G Golem
summary: The G Golem strategy is an EARTH Cyberse co-linking beatdown archetype led by G Golem Rock Hammer, Pebble Dog, and Gravity Balance. Rock Hammer tributes itself to generate 3 EARTH Cyberse Tokens, fueling Link climbs into G Golem Stubborn Menhir and G Golem Crystal Heart. Crystal Heart revives Menhir to trigger its recursion, locking the field under a co-linked G Golem Invalid Dolmen and Dignified Trilithon board immune to opponent's monster effects on the field.

allow.Cynet Mining: Discards G Golem Pebble Dog (triggering its hand-to-GY search effect) to search another Level 4 or lower Cyberse starter.
allow.Dotscaper: Level 1 EARTH Cyberse that Special Summons itself when sent to the GY or banished (synergizing with Gravity Balance), providing the EARTH material required for G Golem Stubborn Menhir.
allow.Widget Kid: Level 3 EARTH Cyberse that Special Summons a Cyberse monster from hand, satisfying both EARTH and Cyberse Link requirements.
allow.Lady Debug: Level 4 Cyberse starter that searches G Golem Pebble Dog, Widget Kid, or Dotscaper on Normal or Special Summon.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Dotscaper or G Golem Pebble Dog to the GY to extend EARTH Cyberse Link plays.
allow.Transcode Talker: Link-3 EARTH Cyberse that revives a Link-3 or lower Cyberse to a co-linked zone, satisfying G Golem Invalid Dolmen's co-link requirement and EARTH Attribute.
allow.Update Jammer: Link-2 WIND Cyberse that allows a Link Monster summoned using it as material to attack twice during each Battle Phase.
allow.Accesscode Talker: Link-4 DARK Cyberse finisher that gains massive ATK and banishes Link Monsters from GY to destroy multiple cards without allowing responses.

main: Searches a copy of itself when Normal/Special Summoned, and searches any 'G Golem' card from the Deck if sent from the hand to the GY.
Discards itself to reduce a G Golem's Level by 2, and tributes itself on the field to summon 3 EARTH Cyberse G Golem Tokens.
Level 1 EARTH Cyberse that revives itself once per Duel when sent to GY and once per Duel when banished by Gravity Balance.
Level 3 EARTH Cyberse that Special Summons Pebble Dog from hand to assemble 2 EARTH monsters for Stubborn Menhir.
Searches G Golem Pebble Dog or Widget Kid on Normal or Special Summon.
Banishes 2 EARTH monsters from GY to Special Summon 2 G Golem monsters with 0 ATK/DEF from GY, and banishes itself from GY to prevent G Golem destruction.
Sends G Golem Pebble Dog from hand to GY (triggering its search for Gravity Balance or Rock Hammer) to add another Cyberse starter.
Limited to 1 in TCG: dumps Dotscaper to immediately place an EARTH Cyberse body on the field.
extra: Link-2 WATER Cyberse that revives an EARTH Link Monster (Stubborn Menhir or Transcode Talker) to its arrow and grants co-linked EARTH monsters double attacks and piercing.
Link-2 EARTH Cyberse that revives or recovers an EARTH monster when Special Summoned from the GY by Crystal Heart.
Link-3 EARTH Cyberse boss that makes all co-linked monsters you control unaffected by monster effects activated on the opponent's field and draws 1 by discarding a Cyberse.
Link-3 EARTH Cyberse boss that sends an EARTH monster from hand to negate an attacking monster and negates opponent's targeting effects on your Link Monsters.
Link-3 EARTH Cyberse that revives Stubborn Menhir or Crystal Heart to a co-linked zone and grants targeting protection.
Link-2 Cyberse extender that grants a co-linked Link boss a second attack during each Battle Phase.
Link-4 Cyberse finisher that destroys opposing cards by banishing Link Monsters from the GY.
